newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish nuns nab "priest" milking church welfare.
newsitem.headline: Polish nuns nab "priest" milking church welfare.

text.p: Alert nuns have nabbed a man accused of travelling Poland impersonating a Catholic priest to get hospitality from church institutions, police said on Monday.
Krakow police said the nuns became suspicious when the phoney priest visited their convent for a second time, wearing clerical garb, but gave a different name.
They called police and a court in the southern Polish city formally placed him under arrest pending investigation.
The man told police he had attended a Catholic seminary for three years and knew enough to be able to celebrate mass at convents that offered him bed and board for a night.
